LU-10 LUBRICATION - OIL PUMP
DISASSEMBLY
1. REMOVE RELIEF VALVE
Remove the plug, spring and relief va!ve.
2. REMOVE DRIVE AND DRIVEN ROTORS

Remove the 3 screws, pump body cover, drive and driven rotors.
(b) 2ZZ-GE:
Remove the 5 screws, pump body cover, drive and driven rotors.
